name: Shenzhen Jieshun Science and Technology Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Jieshun Science and Technology Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides parking operation services in China and internationally. It operates through four segments: Smart Hardware Business, Software and Cloud Services Business, Smart Parking Operation Business, and Parking Asset Operation Business. The company offers parking control machine, lot gate, auxiliary accessories, and payment machine; parking guidance and management, as well as smart lighting; and parking management system and smart parking space product solutions.
